caseA_BS01_012_RelativeBP.canonicalText: This Spirit can't block Spirits with BP inferior to this Spirit's.
caseA_BS01_012_RelativeBP.findings: Compiler dropped relative BP condition and emitted unconditional CANNOT_BLOCK. Engine lacks dynamic relative BP block evaluation.

caseB_NegationsAndProhibitions.findings: Loose regexes on 'can't be' emit generic empty COMBAT_RESTRICTION or absolute INDESTRUCTIBLE, distorting card immunity and activation rules.

caseC_RelativeAndComparativeConditions.findings: Relative BP/cost/core comparison constraints against self or extremes (highest/lowest) are completely omitted in removal operations across 245+ abilities.

caseD_DurationAndTiming.findings: Sentence-based 'once per turn' limits are dropped from header.limit across 737 abilities, allowing infinite or repeated effect activations in engine.

caseE_CompoundAndConditionalEffects.findings: Prerequisite execution dependencies ('If you do', 'When you've done so') are unlinked, executing follow-up actions unconditionally.

caseF_NumericalParameters.findings: Zero-depletion protection ('can't bring cores down to 0') is actively stripped by clause_splitter.js as reminder text.
